verdicts.reason: Both reflow the headline well into four centred lines, but both break the original grouping. The LIMITED badge is moved to the right of the CTA and floats loose. The CTA row is left-weighted under a centred headline, so the axis is incoherent, and both sit in a cramped band near the bottom. A is slightly worse: its headline nearly touches the side edges and its CTA sits only about 25px from the left edge, while B keeps slightly more comfortable margins.
